title: Mystic Valley Parkway, Medford, Massachusetts
summary: MassDOT and FHWA describe the westbound carriageway. Two separately dated Massachusetts orthophotos locate the paint and shoulder. The 2022 street photograph was held out. The packaged site adds 63 paint pieces and marks the supported shoulder and median surfaces.
measurement: The measured stripe-to-boundary distance was 4.68 m on the supported 16 m section. The middle street photograph estimated 4.50 m and the inventory minimum was 3.05 m. The packaged measurements apply to the verified stretch.
credit: Comparison photograph by morganwahl on KartaView, CC BY-SA 4.0. MassGIS and MassDOT supplied the aerial and survey records.
